row.question: Which option should I choose? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. Every unlocked option that does not certainly kill you is listed; options that cost HP carry hp_after (and, with a forced fight ahead, how that HP compares with the fight's measured cost). Code does not rule HP trades out: that is your call. facts.event.option_outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after each option, by option key. boss_sim on an option: this act's boss fought to the end in simulation with the deck (and HP) that option leaves, against your current deck on the same random seeds: the win rate (calibrated on logged boss fights), the difference ± its standard error, the median HP lost in the won fights and the turns. facts.act_boss_sim gives the start, the method and its limits; it replaces the act boss clock. ALSO DUE NOW: your run plan (state.run_plan_task says why, and where your current plan is). Settle it first, then decide this question with it in mind. You set the STRATEGY for the rest of this act and run; code and a small model will apply it to card rewards, shops, removals, map routes and rest sites, and will play every card themselves. Look at the deck, relics, HP, gold, potions, the act boss and the map ahead (memory.lookahead). Name what this deck needs to beat the act boss and survive the act. act_boss_clock gives the boss's HP at this ascension (heals and wasted hits included), the turns you survive at its logged damage and so the turns the fight can last, the damage a turn that needs, and code's estimate of this deck's damage a turn in that fight (calibrated on logged A8 boss fights; Strength growth and the boss mechanic in harder_because counted). If gap_per_turn > 0, closing it comes first: want Strength/scaling and high-damage cards (AoE for two-part bosses), remove Strikes/Defends that dilute them, smith attacks; state the gap in the summary. A gap of 0 is not a reason to stop adding damage: the estimate's typical error is ~25%. Reply to this question in its own JSON format as asked, with one more field in the same JSON object: "run_plan": {"archetype": "<the deck direction, max 12 words>", "want": [card ids to pick when offered, most important first, max 6], "avoid": [card ids not to take, max 6], "remove": [card ids in the deck to remove first, max 3], "block_target": <number of block cards the deck should hold by the act boss>, "elites": "seek" | "normal" | "avoid", "rest": "heal" | "smith" | "auto", "boss_prep": "<max 30 words: what to have ready for the act boss>", "summary": "<max 40 words: the plan in plain words>"}

act_boss_sim.quantitative_uncertainty: 模拟分布不是实际结果；p10–p90是样本结果波动，meanSe是均值的蒙特卡洛误差，不含机制/策略偏差。增加样本不能修复模型偏差；零次/全胜样本不证明必死/必胜。超时完成样本可能有选择偏差，capped是未结束，不能当已败；胜率区间仅指模拟终止前获胜。

act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）
act_boss_sim.limits: 格挡牌和防守能力牌的价值可能被低估（模拟策略跨回合的防守不如实际）；模拟的战斗比实际更确定，单张牌带来的差可能被放大（校准只把绝对胜率拉准）；随机药水不在模拟里；进场血量是投影的中位数，实际会有高低；离本幕 boss 还远时，现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多

row.question: Which of these card rewards should I take, if any? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. in_deck: copies of that card already in your deck. state.route_review 是本幕路线：完整地图（map，节点 id 规则见 map_legend）、你的位置和下一步可走的节点（next_nodes）、你的路线计划（plan，代码按它逐个节点走）和按现在 HP 算的计划事实（plan_facts）。先定路线，再定本题：在同一个 JSON 里加 "route"："keep"（默认，照计划走）或新的节点序列（从 next_nodes 之一出发，沿连线或用飞行靴，一直到 boss，节点 id 用空格分隔），以及 "route_reason"（15 字以内）。next_rest 是保留（keep，你的计划）和换线（switch，经每个下一步节点）各自到下一个休息点的战斗数和到达 HP、下一只精英的进场 HP：改线前比一比。

row.question: Which of these card rewards should I take, if any? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. in_deck: copies of that card already in your deck. state.route_review 是本幕路线：完整地图（map，节点 id 规则见 map_legend）、你的位置和下一步可走的节点（next_nodes）、你的路线计划（plan，代码按它逐个节点走）和按现在 HP 算的计划事实（plan_facts）。先定路线，再定本题：在同一个 JSON 里加 "route"："keep"（默认，照计划走）或新的节点序列（从 next_nodes 之一出发，沿连线或用飞行靴，一直到 boss，节点 id 用空格分隔），以及 "route_reason"（15 字以内）。next_rest 是保留（keep，你的计划）和换线（switch，经每个下一步节点）各自到下一个休息点的战斗数和到达 HP、下一只精英的进场 HP：改线前比一比。

row.question: Which of these card rewards should I take, if any? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. in_deck: copies of that card already in your deck. state.route_review 是本幕路线：完整地图（map，节点 id 规则见 map_legend）、你的位置和下一步可走的节点（next_nodes）、你的路线计划（plan，代码按它逐个节点走）和按现在 HP 算的计划事实（plan_facts）。先定路线，再定本题：在同一个 JSON 里加 "route"："keep"（默认，照计划走）或新的节点序列（从 next_nodes 之一出发，沿连线或用飞行靴，一直到 boss，节点 id 用空格分隔），以及 "route_reason"（15 字以内）。next_rest 是保留（keep，你的计划）和换线（switch，经每个下一步节点）各自到下一个休息点的战斗数和到达 HP、下一只精英的进场 HP：改线前比一比。 boss_sim on an option: this act's boss fought to the end in simulation with the deck (and HP) that option leaves, against your current deck on the same random seeds: the win rate (calibrated on logged boss fights), the difference ± its standard error, the median HP lost in the won fights and the turns. facts.act_boss_sim gives the start, the method and its limits; it replaces the act boss clock.

act_boss_sim.quantitative_uncertainty: 模拟分布不是实际结果；p10–p90是样本结果波动，meanSe是均值的蒙特卡洛误差，不含机制/策略偏差。增加样本不能修复模型偏差；零次/全胜样本不证明必死/必胜。超时完成样本可能有选择偏差，capped是未结束，不能当已败；胜率区间仅指模拟终止前获胜。

act_boss_sim.samples: 每个选项 384 次（目标 1000，到时间只跑完这些）；所有选项同一组随机种子，按样本配对比较；用时 11.1 秒
act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）
act_boss_sim.limits: 格挡牌和防守能力牌的价值可能被低估（模拟策略跨回合的防守不如实际）；模拟的战斗比实际更确定，单张牌带来的差可能被放大（校准只把绝对胜率拉准）；随机药水不在模拟里；进场血量是投影的中位数，实际会有高低；离本幕 boss 还远时，现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多
act_boss_sim.low_win_rate: 当前牌组在模拟里多半打不过（原始胜率 0%，校准后的数不会低于 0.0%，0 胜的读数）：胜率的差信息少，各选项另给 boss 平均剩血（赢的样本算 0）和它的配对差；离 boss 还远时现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多

row.question: Which of these card rewards should I take, if any? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. in_deck: copies of that card already in your deck. state.route_review 是本幕路线：完整地图（map，节点 id 规则见 map_legend）、你的位置和下一步可走的节点（next_nodes）、你的路线计划（plan，代码按它逐个节点走）和按现在 HP 算的计划事实（plan_facts）。先定路线，再定本题：在同一个 JSON 里加 "route"："keep"（默认，照计划走）或新的节点序列（从 next_nodes 之一出发，沿连线或用飞行靴，一直到 boss，节点 id 用空格分隔），以及 "route_reason"（15 字以内）。next_rest 是保留（keep，你的计划）和换线（switch，经每个下一步节点）各自到下一个休息点的战斗数和到达 HP、下一只精英的进场 HP：改线前比一比。 boss_sim on an option: this act's boss fought to the end in simulation with the deck (and HP) that option leaves, against your current deck on the same random seeds: the win rate (calibrated on logged boss fights), the difference ± its standard error, the median HP lost in the won fights and the turns. facts.act_boss_sim gives the start, the method and its limits; it replaces the act boss clock.

act_boss_sim.quantitative_uncertainty: 模拟分布不是实际结果；p10–p90是样本结果波动，meanSe是均值的蒙特卡洛误差，不含机制/策略偏差。增加样本不能修复模型偏差；零次/全胜样本不证明必死/必胜。超时完成样本可能有选择偏差，capped是未结束，不能当已败；胜率区间仅指模拟终止前获胜。

act_boss_sim.samples: 每个选项 336 次（目标 1000，到时间只跑完这些）；所有选项同一组随机种子，按样本配对比较；用时 11.1 秒
act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）
act_boss_sim.limits: 格挡牌和防守能力牌的价值可能被低估（模拟策略跨回合的防守不如实际）；模拟的战斗比实际更确定，单张牌带来的差可能被放大（校准只把绝对胜率拉准）；随机药水不在模拟里；进场血量是投影的中位数，实际会有高低；离本幕 boss 还远时，现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多
act_boss_sim.low_win_rate: 当前牌组在模拟里多半打不过（原始胜率 0%，校准后的数不会低于 0.0%，0 胜的读数）：胜率的差信息少，各选项另给 boss 平均剩血（赢的样本算 0）和它的配对差；离 boss 还远时现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多

facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-12T19:28:47，A10 共 206 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 206 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 75% (n=206)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 49% (n=155)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 3% (n=76)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

row.question: Which option should I choose? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. Every unlocked option that does not certainly kill you is listed; options that cost HP carry hp_after (and, with a forced fight ahead, how that HP compares with the fight's measured cost). Code does not rule HP trades out: that is your call. facts.event.option_outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after each option, by option key. A "discard potion(s), then …" option (key ending ":discard") also needs "discard": [potion slot numbers from its discardable_potions] in your answer; code discards those, then takes the option. state.route_review 是本幕路线：完整地图（map，节点 id 规则见 map_legend）、你的位置和下一步可走的节点（next_nodes）、你的路线计划（plan，代码按它逐个节点走）和按现在 HP 算的计划事实（plan_facts）。先定路线，再定本题：在同一个 JSON 里加 "route"："keep"（默认，照计划走）或新的节点序列（从 next_nodes 之一出发，沿连线或用飞行靴，一直到 boss，节点 id 用空格分隔），以及 "route_reason"（15 字以内）。next_rest 是保留（keep，你的计划）和换线（switch，经每个下一步节点）各自到下一个休息点的战斗数和到达 HP、下一只精英的进场 HP：改线前比一比。 boss_sim on an option: this act's boss fought to the end in simulation with the deck (and HP) that option leaves, against your current deck on the same random seeds: the win rate (calibrated on logged boss fights), the difference ± its standard error, the median HP lost in the won fights and the turns. facts.act_boss_sim gives the start, the method and its limits; it replaces the act boss clock.

event.text:
踏入漆黑的密室，一道亮光从上方刺破黑暗，与此同时，身后的门砰然关上。

借着光亮，你看到前方的石台上放着一张地图。你有一种强烈的想要拿走它的冲动。

事出反常。

act_boss_sim.quantitative_uncertainty: 模拟分布不是实际结果；p10–p90是样本结果波动，meanSe是均值的蒙特卡洛误差，不含机制/策略偏差。增加样本不能修复模型偏差；零次/全胜样本不证明必死/必胜。超时完成样本可能有选择偏差，capped是未结束，不能当已败；胜率区间仅指模拟终止前获胜。

act_boss_sim.samples: 每个选项 440 次（目标 1000，到时间只跑完这些）；所有选项同一组随机种子，按样本配对比较；用时 11.1 秒
act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）
act_boss_sim.limits: 格挡牌和防守能力牌的价值可能被低估（模拟策略跨回合的防守不如实际）；模拟的战斗比实际更确定，单张牌带来的差可能被放大（校准只把绝对胜率拉准）；随机药水不在模拟里；进场血量是投影的中位数，实际会有高低；离本幕 boss 还远时，现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多
act_boss_sim.low_win_rate: 当前牌组在模拟里多半打不过（原始胜率 0%，校准后的数不会低于 0.0%，0 胜的读数）：胜率的差信息少，各选项另给 boss 平均剩血（赢的样本算 0）和它的配对差；离 boss 还远时现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多

row.question: Which option should I choose? An option that makes you pick card(s) from your deck is listed once per card (key option:card, e.g. o1:c5); one that takes several cards lists its eligible_cards: then also answer "cards": [card keys]. Code plays the option and the card pick(s). You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. Every unlocked option that does not certainly kill you is listed; options that cost HP carry hp_after (and, with a forced fight ahead, how that HP compares with the fight's measured cost). Code does not rule HP trades out: that is your call. facts.event.option_outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after each option, by option key. state.route_review 是本幕路线：完整地图（map，节点 id 规则见 map_legend）、你的位置和下一步可走的节点（next_nodes）、你的路线计划（plan，代码按它逐个节点走）和按现在 HP 算的计划事实（plan_facts）。先定路线，再定本题：在同一个 JSON 里加 "route"："keep"（默认，照计划走）或新的节点序列（从 next_nodes 之一出发，沿连线或用飞行靴，一直到 boss，节点 id 用空格分隔），以及 "route_reason"（15 字以内）。next_rest 是保留（keep，你的计划）和换线（switch，经每个下一步节点）各自到下一个休息点的战斗数和到达 HP、下一只精英的进场 HP：改线前比一比。

event.title: 蓝宝石种子
event.text:
你走路时差点踩上了一块发光的尖锐……种子？它的颜色非常明确地表明了这是一枚[aqua]蓝宝石种子[/aqua]！这些稀有种子不是应该已经灭绝了吗！？

传说里，只要吃下一粒这个种子，就能大幅[gold]强化你的体能[/gold]，但如果你把它种下然后好好养育它，又会怎么样呢？

row.question: Which of these card rewards should I take, if any? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. in_deck: copies of that card already in your deck. state.route_review 是本幕路线：完整地图（map，节点 id 规则见 map_legend）、你的位置和下一步可走的节点（next_nodes）、你的路线计划（plan，代码按它逐个节点走）和按现在 HP 算的计划事实（plan_facts）。先定路线，再定本题：在同一个 JSON 里加 "route"："keep"（默认，照计划走）或新的节点序列（从 next_nodes 之一出发，沿连线或用飞行靴，一直到 boss，节点 id 用空格分隔），以及 "route_reason"（15 字以内）。next_rest 是保留（keep，你的计划）和换线（switch，经每个下一步节点）各自到下一个休息点的战斗数和到达 HP、下一只精英的进场 HP：改线前比一比。

facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-12T19:28:47，A10 共 206 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 206 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 75% (n=206)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 49% (n=155)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 3% (n=76)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

row.question: What should I buy in this shop, in what order? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. Plan this whole shop visit in ONE answer: an ordered shopping list that code carries out step by step, re-checking each step against the live shop. Reply with JSON only: {"plan": [<steps in order>], "reason": "<max 40 words>"}. A step is an option key (buy_relicN / buy_cardN / buy_potionN), "remove:<card key>" to pay for the card removal and remove that card (card keys are state.your_cards), or discard_potionN to empty a potion slot first (buying a potion needs an empty slot). Leaving is implied after the last step; [] buys nothing. Unaffordable items are listed as facts (affordable_now false); gold only goes down in a shop, so the whole list must fit your gold at the listed prices (check the sum). You are asked again only if the shop changes under the plan (an item the plan still buys changes price, is gone or cannot be bought, or new stock appears in a slot the plan did not buy).

your_run_plan.boss_prep: Bring area damage to remove followers, sustained damage, upgraded weakness and efficient block, high entry HP, and two useful potions. Avoid prolonged Ritual scaling.

row.question: TASK: run plan (not an option choice; ignore the {choice, reason} reply format for this one). You set the STRATEGY for the rest of this act and run; code and a small model will apply it to card rewards, shops, removals, map routes and rest sites, and will play every card themselves. Look at the deck, relics, HP, gold, potions, the act boss and the map ahead (memory.lookahead). Name what this deck needs to beat the act boss and survive the act. act_boss_clock gives the boss's HP at this ascension (heals and wasted hits included), the turns you survive at its logged damage and so the turns the fight can last, the damage a turn that needs, and code's estimate of this deck's damage a turn in that fight (calibrated on logged A8 boss fights; Strength growth and the boss mechanic in harder_because counted). If gap_per_turn > 0, closing it comes first: want Strength/scaling and high-damage cards (AoE for two-part bosses), remove Strikes/Defends that dilute them, smith attacks; state the gap in the summary. row.question: What should I do at this rest site? Heal, smith a named card (one option per card that can be upgraded, with what the upgrade changes), or another rest action; code plays the action and the card pick. You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. Each smith option names its card: code upgrades that card on the next screen without asking again. state.route_review 是本幕路线：完整地图（map，节点 id 规则见 map_legend）、你的位置和下一步可走的节点（next_nodes）、你的路线计划（plan，代码按它逐个节点走）和按现在 HP 算的计划事实（plan_facts）。先定路线，再定本题：在同一个 JSON 里加 "route"："keep"（默认，照计划走）或新的节点序列（从 next_nodes 之一出发，沿连线或用飞行靴，一直到 boss，节点 id 用空格分隔），以及 "route_reason"（15 字以内）。next_rest 是保留（keep，你的计划）和换线（switch，经每个下一步节点）各自到下一个休息点的战斗数和到达 HP、下一只精英的进场 HP：改线前比一比。plan_facts.if_option 是本题每个选项之后的 HP 对应的下一只精英和 boss 前血量。

row.question: Which of these card rewards should I take, if any? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. in_deck: copies of that card already in your deck. state.route_review 是本幕路线：完整地图（map，节点 id 规则见 map_legend）、你的位置和下一步可走的节点（next_nodes）、你的路线计划（plan，代码按它逐个节点走）和按现在 HP 算的计划事实（plan_facts）。先定路线，再定本题：在同一个 JSON 里加 "route"："keep"（默认，照计划走）或新的节点序列（从 next_nodes 之一出发，沿连线或用飞行靴，一直到 boss，节点 id 用空格分隔），以及 "route_reason"（15 字以内）。next_rest 是保留（keep，你的计划）和换线（switch，经每个下一步节点）各自到下一个休息点的战斗数和到达 HP、下一只精英的进场 HP：改线前比一比。

row.question: Which of these card rewards should I take, if any? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. in_deck: copies of that card already in your deck. state.route_review 是本幕路线：完整地图（map，节点 id 规则见 map_legend）、你的位置和下一步可走的节点（next_nodes）、你的路线计划（plan，代码按它逐个节点走）和按现在 HP 算的计划事实（plan_facts）。先定路线，再定本题：在同一个 JSON 里加 "route"："keep"（默认，照计划走）或新的节点序列（从 next_nodes 之一出发，沿连线或用飞行靴，一直到 boss，节点 id 用空格分隔），以及 "route_reason"（15 字以内）。next_rest 是保留（keep，你的计划）和换线（switch，经每个下一步节点）各自到下一个休息点的战斗数和到达 HP、下一只精英的进场 HP：改线前比一比。

facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-12T19:28:47，A10 共 206 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 206 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 75% (n=206)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 49% (n=155)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 3% (n=76)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

row.question: Which of these card rewards should I take, if any? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. in_deck: copies of that card already in your deck. boss_sim on an option: this act's boss fought to the end in simulation with the deck (and HP) that option leaves, against your current deck on the same random seeds: the win rate (calibrated on logged boss fights), the difference ± its standard error, the median HP lost in the won fights and the turns. facts.act_boss_sim gives the start, the method and its limits; it replaces the act boss clock.

act_boss_sim.quantitative_uncertainty: 模拟分布不是实际结果；p10–p90是样本结果波动，meanSe是均值的蒙特卡洛误差，不含机制/策略偏差。增加样本不能修复模型偏差；零次/全胜样本不证明必死/必胜。超时完成样本可能有选择偏差，capped是未结束，不能当已败；胜率区间仅指模拟终止前获胜。

act_boss_sim.samples: 每个选项 312 次（目标 1000，到时间只跑完这些）；所有选项同一组随机种子，按样本配对比较；用时 11.1 秒
act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）
act_boss_sim.limits: 格挡牌和防守能力牌的价值可能被低估（模拟策略跨回合的防守不如实际）；模拟的战斗比实际更确定，单张牌带来的差可能被放大（校准只把绝对胜率拉准）；随机药水不在模拟里；进场血量是投影的中位数，实际会有高低；离本幕 boss 还远时，现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多

row.question: What should I do at this rest site? Heal, smith a named card (one option per card that can be upgraded, with what the upgrade changes), or another rest action; code plays the action and the card pick. You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. Each smith option names its card: code upgrades that card on the next screen without asking again.

facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-12T19:28:47，A10 共 206 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 206 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 75% (n=206)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 49% (n=155)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 3% (n=76)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

row.question: Which of the Ancient's options should I take, and which route should I follow this act? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. Every unlocked option that does not certainly kill you is listed; options that cost HP carry hp_after (and, with a forced fight ahead, how that HP compares with the fight's measured cost). Code does not rule HP trades out: that is your call. facts.event.option_outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after each option, by option key. 幕初：远古的选项和本幕路线一起定。state.act_route 是本幕完整地图（你在远古节点上，节点 id 规则见 map_legend）。回答 JSON：{"choice": "<选项 key>", "route": "<节点 id，用空格分隔：从 next_nodes 之一出发，沿连线（或用飞行靴）一直到 boss>", "reason": "<30 字以内>"}（选项列出 eligible_cards 时再加 "cards"）。选项改变 HP、最大生命或金币时写在它的 route_effect 里。代码先执行选项，再按路线逐个节点走，只在路线走不通时再问你；选项结果随机时，揭晓后在第一张地图问一次保留还是换路线；之后的选牌、休息点和事件的最后一问也会附上路线让你保留或修改。state.act_route.candidate_routes 是代码按投影列的几条到 boss 的路线，每段的战斗、精英进场和到达休息点、boss 的 HP（事实，不是选项）。 ALSO DUE NOW: your run plan (state.run_plan_task says why, and where your current plan is). Settle it first, then decide this question with it in mind. You set the STRATEGY for the rest of this act and run; code and a small model will apply it to card rewards, shops, removals, map routes and rest sites, and will play every card themselves. Look at the deck, relics, HP, gold, potions, the act boss and the map ahead (memory.lookahead). Name what this deck needs to beat the act boss and survive the act. act_boss_clock gives the boss's HP at this ascension (heals and wasted hits included), the turns you survive at its logged damage and so the turns the fight can last, the damage a turn that needs, and code's estimate of this deck's damage a turn in that fight (calibrated on logged A8 boss fights; Strength growth and the boss mechanic in harder_because counted). If gap_per_turn > 0, closing it comes first: want Strength/scaling and high-damage cards (AoE for two-part bosses), remove Strikes/Defends that dilute them, smith attacks; state the gap in the summary. A gap of 0 is not a reason to stop adding damage: the estimate's typical error is ~25%. Reply to this question in its own JSON format as asked, with one more field in the same JSON object: "run_plan": {"archetype": "<the deck direction, max 12 words>", "want": [card ids to pick when offered, most important first, max 6], "avoid": [card ids not to take, max 6], "remove": [card ids in the deck to remove first, max 3], "block_target": <number of block cards the deck should hold by the act boss>, "elites": "seek" | "normal" | "avoid", "rest": "heal" | "smith" | "auto", "boss_prep": "<max 30 words: what to have ready for the act boss>", "summary": "<max 40 words: the plan in plain words>"}

row.question: Which of these card rewards should I take, if any? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. in_deck: copies of that card already in your deck. state.route_review 是本幕路线：完整地图（map，节点 id 规则见 map_legend）、你的位置和下一步可走的节点（next_nodes）、你的路线计划（plan，代码按它逐个节点走）和按现在 HP 算的计划事实（plan_facts）。先定路线，再定本题：在同一个 JSON 里加 "route"："keep"（默认，照计划走）或新的节点序列（从 next_nodes 之一出发，沿连线或用飞行靴，一直到 boss，节点 id 用空格分隔），以及 "route_reason"（15 字以内）。next_rest 是保留（keep，你的计划）和换线（switch，经每个下一步节点）各自到下一个休息点的战斗数和到达 HP、下一只精英的进场 HP：改线前比一比。 boss_sim on an option: this act's boss fought to the end in simulation with the deck (and HP) that option leaves, against your current deck on the same random seeds: the win rate (calibrated on logged boss fights), the difference ± its standard error, the median HP lost in the won fights and the turns. facts.act_boss_sim gives the start, the method and its limits; it replaces the act boss clock.

act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）
act_boss_sim.limits: 格挡牌和防守能力牌的价值可能被低估（模拟策略跨回合的防守不如实际）；模拟的战斗比实际更确定，单张牌带来的差可能被放大（校准只把绝对胜率拉准）；随机药水不在模拟里；进场血量是投影的中位数，实际会有高低；离本幕 boss 还远时，现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多
act_boss_sim.low_win_rate: 当前牌组在模拟里多半打不过（原始胜率 0%，校准后的数不会低于 0.0%，0 胜的读数）：胜率的差信息少，各选项另给 boss 平均剩血（赢的样本算 0）和它的配对差；离 boss 还远时现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多

your_run_plan.archetype: Poison scaling with dexterity defense and banked energy
your_run_plan.boss_prep: Upgrade Footwork, Noxious Fumes, and Accelerant. Secure efficient block, weakness, and two useful potions. Face Rocket during beam turns; account for survivor enrage.
your_run_plan.summary: Bank energy with Tears when essential defense permits. Buy scaling and block early; take one prepared elite after healing, then favor events, late shopping, and recovery. Remove Strikes and upgrade core powers when healthy.

facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-12T19:28:47，A10 共 206 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 206 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 75% (n=206)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 49% (n=155)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 3% (n=76)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

row.question: Which option should I choose? An option that makes you pick card(s) from your deck is listed once per card (key option:card, e.g. o1:c5); one that takes several cards lists its eligible_cards: then also answer "cards": [card keys]. Code plays the option and the card pick(s). You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. Every unlocked option that does not certainly kill you is listed; options that cost HP carry hp_after (and, with a forced fight ahead, how that HP compares with the fight's measured cost). Code does not rule HP trades out: that is your call. facts.event.option_outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after each option, by option key. state.route_review 是本幕路线：完整地图（map，节点 id 规则见 map_legend）、你的位置和下一步可走的节点（next_nodes）、你的路线计划（plan，代码按它逐个节点走）和按现在 HP 算的计划事实（plan_facts）。先定路线，再定本题：在同一个 JSON 里加 "route"："keep"（默认，照计划走）或新的节点序列（从 next_nodes 之一出发，沿连线或用飞行靴，一直到 boss，节点 id 用空格分隔），以及 "route_reason"（15 字以内）。next_rest 是保留（keep，你的计划）和换线（switch，经每个下一步节点）各自到下一个休息点的战斗数和到达 HP、下一只精英的进场 HP：改线前比一比。 boss_sim on an option: this act's boss fought to the end in simulation with the deck (and HP) that option leaves, against your current deck on the same random seeds: the win rate (calibrated on logged boss fights), the difference ± its standard error, the median HP lost in the won fights and the turns. facts.act_boss_sim gives the start, the method and its limits; it replaces the act boss clock.

event.title: 修禅织网者
event.text:
你在行走时撞到了一张蜘蛛网，立即[jitter][red]慌了神[/red][/jitter]！
可是很快，一阵[sine][blue]平静的感觉[/blue][/sine]席卷了你……

[sine]“冷静下来，我需要你不再弄坏我的网。”[/sine]

你怎么会这么快就冷静下来的呢？
一只[orange]小之又小[/orange]的蜘蛛沿着丝线降落下来与你问好，它看起来愿意收取一些[gold]金币[/gold]来分享它的部分技术。

act_boss_sim.quantitative_uncertainty: 模拟分布不是实际结果；p10–p90是样本结果波动，meanSe是均值的蒙特卡洛误差，不含机制/策略偏差。增加样本不能修复模型偏差；零次/全胜样本不证明必死/必胜。超时完成样本可能有选择偏差，capped是未结束，不能当已败；胜率区间仅指模拟终止前获胜。

act_boss_sim.samples: 每个选项 320 次（目标 1000，到时间只跑完这些）；所有选项同一组随机种子，按样本配对比较；用时 11.1 秒
act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）
act_boss_sim.limits: 格挡牌和防守能力牌的价值可能被低估（模拟策略跨回合的防守不如实际）；模拟的战斗比实际更确定，单张牌带来的差可能被放大（校准只把绝对胜率拉准）；随机药水不在模拟里；进场血量是投影的中位数，实际会有高低；离本幕 boss 还远时，现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多
act_boss_sim.low_win_rate: 当前牌组在模拟里多半打不过（原始胜率 0%，校准后的数不会低于 0.0%，0 胜的读数）：胜率的差信息少，各选项另给 boss 平均剩血（赢的样本算 0）和它的配对差；离 boss 还远时现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多

row.question: What should I buy in this shop, in what order? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. Plan this whole shop visit in ONE answer: an ordered shopping list that code carries out step by step, re-checking each step against the live shop. Reply with JSON only: {"plan": [<steps in order>], "reason": "<max 40 words>"}. A step is an option key (buy_relicN / buy_cardN / buy_potionN), "remove:<card key>" to pay for the card removal and remove that card (card keys are state.your_cards), or discard_potionN to empty a potion slot first (buying a potion needs an empty slot). Leaving is implied after the last step; [] buys nothing. Unaffordable items are listed as facts (affordable_now false); gold only goes down in a shop, so the whole list must fit your gold at the listed prices (check the sum). You are asked again only if the shop changes under the plan (an item the plan still buys changes price, is gone or cannot be bought, or new stock appears in a slot the plan did not buy).

row.question: Which option should I choose? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. Every unlocked option that does not certainly kill you is listed; options that cost HP carry hp_after (and, with a forced fight ahead, how that HP compares with the fight's measured cost). Code does not rule HP trades out: that is your call. facts.event.option_outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after each option, by option key. state.route_review 是本幕路线：完整地图（map，节点 id 规则见 map_legend）、你的位置和下一步可走的节点（next_nodes）、你的路线计划（plan，代码按它逐个节点走）和按现在 HP 算的计划事实（plan_facts）。先定路线，再定本题：在同一个 JSON 里加 "route"："keep"（默认，照计划走）或新的节点序列（从 next_nodes 之一出发，沿连线或用飞行靴，一直到 boss，节点 id 用空格分隔），以及 "route_reason"（15 字以内）。next_rest 是保留（keep，你的计划）和换线（switch，经每个下一步节点）各自到下一个休息点的战斗数和到达 HP、下一只精英的进场 HP：改线前比一比。 boss_sim on an option: this act's boss fought to the end in simulation with the deck (and HP) that option leaves, against your current deck on the same random seeds: the win rate (calibrated on logged boss fights), the difference ± its standard error, the median HP lost in the won fights and the turns. facts.act_boss_sim gives the start, the method and its limits; it replaces the act boss clock.

event.text:
转过拐角，你感受到一阵轻微的轰鸣，随后发现了一台巨大的旋转装置！

将这些药水炼成一小片的想法令人有些不适，但或许尝试新事物也不错？

act_boss_sim.quantitative_uncertainty: 模拟分布不是实际结果；p10–p90是样本结果波动，meanSe是均值的蒙特卡洛误差，不含机制/策略偏差。增加样本不能修复模型偏差；零次/全胜样本不证明必死/必胜。超时完成样本可能有选择偏差，capped是未结束，不能当已败；胜率区间仅指模拟终止前获胜。

act_boss_sim.entry_hp: 81/81：本幕路线计划到 boss（F33）的中位投影，和 route_review.plan_facts.boss 同一个算法

act_boss_sim.samples: 每个选项 1000 次；所有选项同一组随机种子，按样本配对比较；用时 3.5 秒
act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）
act_boss_sim.limits: 格挡牌和防守能力牌的价值可能被低估（模拟策略跨回合的防守不如实际）；模拟的战斗比实际更确定，单张牌带来的差可能被放大（校准只把绝对胜率拉准）；随机药水不在模拟里；进场血量是投影的中位数，实际会有高低；离本幕 boss 还远时，现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多
act_boss_sim.low_win_rate: 当前牌组在模拟里多半打不过（原始胜率 0%，校准后的数不会低于 0.0%，0 胜的读数）：胜率的差信息少，各选项另给 boss 平均剩血（赢的样本算 0）和它的配对差；离 boss 还远时现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多

row.question: Which of these card rewards should I take, if any? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. in_deck: copies of that card already in your deck. state.route_review 是本幕路线：完整地图（map，节点 id 规则见 map_legend）、你的位置和下一步可走的节点（next_nodes）、你的路线计划（plan，代码按它逐个节点走）和按现在 HP 算的计划事实（plan_facts）。先定路线，再定本题：在同一个 JSON 里加 "route"："keep"（默认，照计划走）或新的节点序列（从 next_nodes 之一出发，沿连线或用飞行靴，一直到 boss，节点 id 用空格分隔），以及 "route_reason"（15 字以内）。next_rest 是保留（keep，你的计划）和换线（switch，经每个下一步节点）各自到下一个休息点的战斗数和到达 HP、下一只精英的进场 HP：改线前比一比。 boss_sim on an option: this act's boss fought to the end in simulation with the deck (and HP) that option leaves, against your current deck on the same random seeds: the win rate (calibrated on logged boss fights), the difference ± its standard error, the median HP lost in the won fights and the turns. facts.act_boss_sim gives the start, the method and its limits; it replaces the act boss clock.

act_boss_sim.quantitative_uncertainty: 模拟分布不是实际结果；p10–p90是样本结果波动，meanSe是均值的蒙特卡洛误差，不含机制/策略偏差。增加样本不能修复模型偏差；零次/全胜样本不证明必死/必胜。超时完成样本可能有选择偏差，capped是未结束，不能当已败；胜率区间仅指模拟终止前获胜。

act_boss_sim.samples: 每个选项 1000 次；所有选项同一组随机种子，按样本配对比较；用时 8.6 秒
act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）
act_boss_sim.limits: 格挡牌和防守能力牌的价值可能被低估（模拟策略跨回合的防守不如实际）；模拟的战斗比实际更确定，单张牌带来的差可能被放大（校准只把绝对胜率拉准）；随机药水不在模拟里；进场血量是投影的中位数，实际会有高低；离本幕 boss 还远时，现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多
act_boss_sim.low_win_rate: 当前牌组在模拟里多半打不过（原始胜率 0%，校准后的数不会低于 0.0%，0 胜的读数）：胜率的差信息少，各选项另给 boss 平均剩血（赢的样本算 0）和它的配对差；离 boss 还远时现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多

row.question: Which of these card rewards should I take, if any? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. in_deck: copies of that card already in your deck. state.route_review 是本幕路线：完整地图（map，节点 id 规则见 map_legend）、你的位置和下一步可走的节点（next_nodes）、你的路线计划（plan，代码按它逐个节点走）和按现在 HP 算的计划事实（plan_facts）。先定路线，再定本题：在同一个 JSON 里加 "route"："keep"（默认，照计划走）或新的节点序列（从 next_nodes 之一出发，沿连线或用飞行靴，一直到 boss，节点 id 用空格分隔），以及 "route_reason"（15 字以内）。next_rest 是保留（keep，你的计划）和换线（switch，经每个下一步节点）各自到下一个休息点的战斗数和到达 HP、下一只精英的进场 HP：改线前比一比。 boss_sim on an option: this act's boss fought to the end in simulation with the deck (and HP) that option leaves, against your current deck on the same random seeds: the win rate (calibrated on logged boss fights), the difference ± its standard error, the median HP lost in the won fights and the turns. facts.act_boss_sim gives the start, the method and its limits; it replaces the act boss clock.

act_boss_sim.entry_hp: 79/81：本幕路线计划到 boss（F33）的中位投影，和 route_review.plan_facts.boss 同一个算法
act_boss_sim.current_deck: 胜率 0%（校准后；原始 0%），赢局掉血中位 —，赢局约 5 回合，输的样本中位死在第 5 回合
act_boss_sim.samples: 每个选项 1000 次；所有选项同一组随机种子，按样本配对比较；用时 10.7 秒
act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）
act_boss_sim.limits: 格挡牌和防守能力牌的价值可能被低估（模拟策略跨回合的防守不如实际）；模拟的战斗比实际更确定，单张牌带来的差可能被放大（校准只把绝对胜率拉准）；随机药水不在模拟里；进场血量是投影的中位数，实际会有高低；离本幕 boss 还远时，现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多
act_boss_sim.low_win_rate: 当前牌组在模拟里多半打不过（原始胜率 0%，校准后的数不会低于 0.0%，0 胜的读数）：胜率的差信息少，各选项另给 boss 平均剩血（赢的样本算 0）和它的配对差；离 boss 还远时现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多

your_run_plan.archetype: Poison scaling with dexterity defense and banked energy
your_run_plan.boss_prep: Upgrade Footwork, Noxious Fumes, and Accelerant. Secure efficient block, weakness, and two useful potions. Face Rocket during beam turns; account for survivor enrage.
your_run_plan.summary: Bank energy with Tears when essential defense permits. Buy scaling and block early; take one prepared elite after healing, then favor events, late shopping, and recovery. Remove Strikes and upgrade core powers when healthy.

facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-12T19:28:47，A10 共 206 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 206 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 75% (n=206)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 49% (n=155)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 3% (n=76)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

row.question: What should I do at this rest site? Heal, smith a named card (one option per card that can be upgraded, with what the upgrade changes), or another rest action; code plays the action and the card pick. You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. Each smith option names its card: code upgrades that card on the next screen without asking again. state.route_review 是本幕路线：完整地图（map，节点 id 规则见 map_legend）、你的位置和下一步可走的节点（next_nodes）、你的路线计划（plan，代码按它逐个节点走）和按现在 HP 算的计划事实（plan_facts）。先定路线，再定本题：在同一个 JSON 里加 "route"："keep"（默认，照计划走）或新的节点序列（从 next_nodes 之一出发，沿连线或用飞行靴，一直到 boss，节点 id 用空格分隔），以及 "route_reason"（15 字以内）。next_rest 是保留（keep，你的计划）和换线（switch，经每个下一步节点）各自到下一个休息点的战斗数和到达 HP、下一只精英的进场 HP：改线前比一比。plan_facts.if_option 是本题每个选项之后的 HP 对应的下一只精英和 boss 前血量。 boss_sim on an option: this act's boss fought to the end in simulation with the deck (and HP) that option leaves, against your current deck on the same random seeds: the win rate (calibrated on logged boss fights), the difference ± its standard error, the median HP lost in the won fights and the turns. facts.act_boss_sim gives the start, the method and its limits; it replaces the act boss clock. ALSO DUE NOW: your run plan (state.run_plan_task says why, and where your current plan is). Settle it first, then decide this question with it in mind. You set the STRATEGY for the rest of this act and run; code and a small model will apply it to card rewards, shops, removals, map routes and rest sites, and will play every card themselves. Look at the deck, relics, HP, gold, potions, the act boss and the map ahead (memory.lookahead). Name what this deck needs to beat the act boss and survive the act. act_boss_clock gives the boss's HP at this ascension (heals and wasted hits included), the turns you survive at its logged damage and so the turns the fight can last, the damage a turn that needs, and code's estimate of this deck's damage a turn in that fight (calibrated on logged A8 boss fights; Strength growth and the boss mechanic in harder_because counted). If gap_per_turn > 0, closing it comes first: want Strength/scaling and high-damage cards (AoE for two-part bosses), remove Strikes/Defends that dilute them, smith attacks; state the gap in the summary. A gap of 0 is not a reason to stop adding damage: the estimate's typical error is ~25%. Reply to this question in its own JSON format as asked, with one more field in the same JSON object: "run_plan": {"archetype": "<the deck direction, max 12 words>", "want": [card ids to pick when offered, most important first, max 6], "avoid": [card ids not to take, max 6], "remove": [card ids in the deck to remove first, max 3], "block_target": <number of block cards the deck should hold by the act boss>, "elites": "seek" | "normal" | "avoid", "rest": "heal" | "smith" | "auto", "boss_prep": "<max 30 words: what to have ready for the act boss>", "summary": "<max 40 words: the plan in plain words>"}

act_boss_sim.samples: 每个选项 416 次（目标 1000，到时间只跑完这些）；所有选项同一组随机种子，按样本配对比较；用时 11.2 秒
act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）
act_boss_sim.limits: 格挡牌和防守能力牌的价值可能被低估（模拟策略跨回合的防守不如实际）；模拟的战斗比实际更确定，单张牌带来的差可能被放大（校准只把绝对胜率拉准）；随机药水不在模拟里；进场血量是投影的中位数，实际会有高低；离本幕 boss 还远时，现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多
act_boss_sim.low_win_rate: 当前牌组在模拟里多半打不过（原始胜率 0%，校准后的数不会低于 0.0%，0 胜的读数）：胜率的差信息少，各选项另给 boss 平均剩血（赢的样本算 0）和它的配对差；离 boss 还远时现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多

your_run_plan.archetype: Poison scaling with dexterity defense and banked energy
your_run_plan.boss_prep: Upgrade Footwork, Noxious Fumes, and Accelerant. Secure efficient block, weakness, and two useful potions. Face Rocket during beam turns; account for survivor enrage.
your_run_plan.summary: Bank energy with Tears when essential defense permits. Buy scaling and block early; take one prepared elite after healing, then favor events, late shopping, and recovery. Remove Strikes and upgrade core powers when healthy.

rest_site.heal_amount: 24 HP: 24 (30% of max HP, rounded down)
rest_site.forced_elite_ahead: every path meets an Elite within 3 nodes, with no rest site or shop before it

facts.unknown_value_note: ?(数值未知) marks a number the mod does not expose; the text around it is accurate
facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-12T19:28:47，A10 共 206 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 206 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 75% (n=206)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 49% (n=155)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 3% (n=76)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

act_boss_clock.boss_hp_note: 数据库本体血量；不含回血或格挡，未观测时未知。各敌人的进阶与样本见 boss_enemies。
act_boss_clock.boss_enemy_note: 攻击是当前进阶的数据库参考，base 为基础伤害，shown 为含当时增减益的现场伤害；借用其他进阶时标 estimated。不是逐回合预测或玩家掉血；击杀顺序、回血、格挡及构筑取舍仍由大脑结合本角色经验判断。
act_boss_clock.estimate_note: 尚无 silent 的 boss 时钟校准；构筑输出、掉血和存活回合未知。

run_plan.archetype: Area poison scaling with reliable block and efficient cycling
run_plan.boss_prep: Upgrade Footwork or Fumes when safe; secure Accelerant, reliable block, and defensive potions. Face Rocket during beams; account for survivor enrage.
run_plan.summary: Heal now and avoid optional elites. Prioritize faster poison damage and reliable defense over additional slow setup. Remove Strikes, use potions against major losses, and bank energy only when immediate survival permits.
